name: refine-matk
author: BlaXun
description: Weapon refining also raises MATK, so magic classes get something out of a blacksmith too. Bonus scales with the weapon's tier and counts both hands for dual-wielders.

settings.label: MATK per +1 refine, Lv1 weapons
settings.description: Daggers, Novice Rods and other Lv1 weapons. Applied per refine level, on each equipped weapon.

settings.label: MATK per +1 refine, Lv2 weapons
settings.description: Rods, one-handed swords, maces and other Lv2 weapons. Applied per refine level, on each equipped weapon.

settings.label: MATK per +1 refine, Lv3 weapons
settings.description: Staves, two-handed swords, spears and other Lv3 weapons. Applied per refine level, on each equipped weapon.

settings.label: MATK per +1 refine, Lv4 weapons
settings.description: Bows, top-tier staves and other Lv4 weapons. Applied per refine level, on each equipped weapon.
